author: Universe Scales
note: Original external morphology illustration of Paramecium caudatum, using a representative 250 µm cell-body length. Martin Kreutz’s microscopy observations document 170–300 µm cells, a rounded anterior, narrower posterior, an anteriorly widening oral groove, 80–120 longitudinal rows of paired cilia, and a tuft of 10–20 µm caudal cilia. This diagram uses 80 rows; ordinary 8 µm cilia and 14 µm caudal cilia, their static bend, spacing, diameter, the body width/depth and precise oral-groove profile are authored simplifications. Cilia extend beyond the calibrated 250 µm body. The cell is opaque for small-scale legibility; internal organelles, trichocysts and refractive contents are omitted. No source photograph is copied, and this is not a scan, measured specimen surface or reconstructed 3D microscopy volume.
